title: A gentle measure allows for change

captions.emotions: Feeling a shift in familiar mood

meaning: Your gentle wish to support each other can withstand change when help remains honest and manageable.
text: Warmth need not look identical every day. In the physical position of Anahata, Justice appears in an honest measure of help agreed around actual capacities. Strength in energy brings a wish to restrain pressure and meet vulnerability gently without suppressing it. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions offers a sense of changing states and circumstances. You may feel cared for even on an uneven day when involvement does not depend on a demand to remain cheerful, grateful and ready for the same amount of closeness throughout.

For example, after a noisy event you intend to look through photographs together, but the mood unexpectedly changes at home: one person needs quiet and simple food. You avoid persuading them to keep the fun going and divide the remaining tasks honestly. **Gentleness allows a change without cancelling care.** The photographs wait for another evening; today’s kind gesture takes the form of a quiet supper without having to perform the earlier excitement.

Patience can conceal an expectation that gentleness must be rewarded with a better mood. A change then feels like unfair payment for effort. Another difficulty is explaining every lapse of attention through a day turning out differently. Closeness benefits from distinguishing changing experience from concrete responsibility: feelings need not remain level, but a promise of help can be clarified honestly.
